"""Round 4. Use actual oil/water and Sw feedback through day 1439 to distinguish early bottom water from the later injection connection."""
from datetime import datetime
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import numpy as np
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(1, str(ROOT.parent))
from compositional_tools import fields
from spatial_tools import native_fields, well_region, path_region
from field_edit import save_candidate

reference = fields(ROOT / "candidates/round1_k_only")
indices, xyz, connections = native_fields()
sw0 = np.fromfile(ROOT / "runs/baseline_tuned/initial_ImmiscibleSaturation.bin")
volume = np.fromfile(ROOT / "runs/baseline_tuned/volumes.bin")
bottom = np.load(ROOT / "topology/bottom_completion_paths.npz")
paths = np.load(ROOT / "topology/paths.npz")
safe = (sw0 < .99) & (reference["PORO"].ravel()[indices] * volume > 1e-3)
log_h = np.zeros(len(indices)); log_z = log_h.copy(); log_phi = log_h.copy()
controls = {
    "P11": {"kh": 1., "kz": 8., "phi": .65, "radius": 180., "vertical": 15.},
    "P12": {"kh": 2.5, "kz": 2., "phi": .35, "radius": 180., "vertical": 20.},
    "P13": {"kh": 1., "kz": 2., "phi": .85, "radius": 220., "vertical": 30.},
    "P14": {"kh": 6., "kz": 2., "phi": .50, "radius": 220., "vertical": 30.},
    "P15": {"kh": 2.7, "kz": 1.75, "phi": .72, "radius": 220., "vertical": 30.},
    "P16": {"kh": 1., "kz": 1., "phi": 1., "radius": 220., "vertical": 30.},
}
for well, control in controls.items():
    path_weight = path_region(xyz, bottom[well], horizontal_radius_m=control["radius"], vertical_radius_m=control["vertical"])
    log_z += np.log(control["kz"]) * path_weight
    log_phi += np.log(control["phi"]) * path_weight * safe
    if well in {"P14", "P15", "P16"}:
        deepest = connections.loc[connections.well == well, "z"].max()
        near = well_region(xyz, connections, well, radius_m=220, vertical_padding_m=45)
        lower = .5 * (1 + np.tanh((xyz[2] - (deepest - 60.)) / 20.))
        weight = np.maximum(path_weight, near * lower)
    else:
        weight = path_weight
    log_h += np.log(control["kh"]) * weight

# Early bottom-water influx at P16 is already excessive, while its subsequent growth is too slow. Test another connection with the injection schedule fixed.
flood = {"connection": "I12-W__P16", "kh": 5., "kz": 4., "phi": .80, "radius": 180., "vertical": 20.}
weight = path_region(xyz, paths[flood["connection"]], horizontal_radius_m=flood["radius"], vertical_radius_m=flood["vertical"])
log_h += np.log(flood["kh"]) * weight
log_z += np.log(flood["kz"]) * weight
log_phi += np.log(flood["phi"]) * weight * safe
changed = {}
for key, factor in [("PERMX", np.exp(log_h)), ("PERMY", np.exp(log_h)),
                    ("PERMZ", np.exp(log_z)), ("PORO", np.exp(log_phi))]:
    value = reference[key].copy(); value.ravel()[indices] *= factor; changed[key] = value
rationale = {
    "decision_time": datetime.now().isoformat(),
    "objective": "Full-period field and well oil and water production. Pressure and gas are outside the selection metric; terminal observations have no additional weight.",
    "feedback_window": "results/round3_oil_water_comparison_day1439.json and actual native responses and Sw from diagnostics_round3_1439 and diagnostics_round2_final_partial. Full-period candidate scores were pending.",
    "available_observations": "All 2891 days of history were available. The experiment used no strict blind or holdout evaluation.",
    "P14": "On day 1439 round three gave 298.32 m3/day of water against 601.79 observed. Water has arrived along the initial bottom-water path, but its contribution is too small. Raise the additional central multiplier on lower-zone Kh from 3 to 6 and retain the previous Kz and porosity settings.",
    "P15": "Round three reduced water-rate RMSE from 125.80 to 21.29 m3/day. At day 1439 the rate was still 297.87 versus 225.996 observed. Reduce Kh slightly from 3 to 2.7 and retain Kz, porosity and the selected region.",
    "p16_timing": "On day 1281 round three gave 27.53 m3/day of water against 4.97 observed, but on day 1439 it gave 51.88 against 158.39. The direction of the error changes with time. Undo round three’s additional bottom-water Kh and porosity edits, restore the round1_k_only reference and test the injector connection separately.",
    "p16_injection_hypothesis": "Historical I12-W injection starts on day 1210. During open intervals, injection-rate P10/P50/P90 is approximately 8387/9972/10192 m3/day. In round two on day 1440, Sw along the static path was about 0.396 at the source and 0.317 in the next cell; the remaining cells toward P16 were still near 0.18. Test inadequate propagation along the injection connection. It is a candidate path, not a confirmed streamline.",
    "p16_additional_path": flood,
    "p16_path_orientation": "The 11-cell path has positive transmissibility, with lateral connections and five vertical connections. Adjust both Kh and Kz using horizontal and vertical length scales of 180 m and 20 m, with truncation at three scales.",
    "P11": "On day 1439 the water rate was 0.403 m3/day against 10.713 observed. Increase Kz near the lowest completion along the bottom-water path and reduce hydrocarbon-bearing pore volume. Narrow the vertical influence scale to 15 m to test slightly earlier water arrival while limiting invasion of higher layers.",
    "P12": "On day 1439 the water rate was 0.802 m3/day against 21.251 observed. Retain the central Kh and Kz multipliers, reduce the pathway porosity multiplier from 0.70 to 0.35 and narrow its spatial extent. Test front arrival time while limiting further increases in inflow capacity at the lowest completion.",
    "P13": "The current water rate is already close to history. Retain the round-three settings and check the late response over the full period.",
    "bottom_water_central_multipliers_and_scales": controls,
    "multiplier_basis": "Kh and Kz are relative to round1_k_only; porosity is relative to the original field. The I12-W to P16 pathway edit is applied smoothly on top of these fields. Evaluate the resulting arrays and any overlap of influence regions with the native simulator.",
    "near_well_region": "For P14/P15 use the lower 60 m with a smooth 20 m transition and a 220 m horizontal scale. Take the maximum of the near-well weight and each bottom-water path weight to avoid multiplying twice. The well region follows the connected completion-cell centers in the model; no separate directional survey is used.",
    "porosity_constraints": "Edit only active cells with initial Sw < 0.99 and cell pore volume > 1e-3 m3. Retain porosity in pure-water regions and keep active-cell porosities strictly between zero and one.",
    "fixed_items": "Retain the original normalized initial composition, nonnegative and summing to one cell by cell. Retain EOS, SCAL, well controls and completions, initial pressure/Sw, temperature, grid, numerical settings and simulator source.",
    "pore_volume_original_m3": float(np.sum(reference["PORO"].ravel()[indices] * volume)),
    "pore_volume_edited_m3": float(np.sum(changed["PORO"].ravel()[indices] * volume)),
    "full_verification_requirements": "Recompute all 516 reports and 2891 days from t0. Partial responses, composition constraints and adherence to the liquid-rate control do not establish a complete history match.",
}
print(save_candidate("round4_connectivity", changed, rationale, parent="round3_timing"))
(ROOT / "round4_decision.json").write_text(json.dumps(rationale, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(rationale, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
